ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic diagram of the Ural River water system. The main stream generally extends from the northeastern part of the figure toward the southwest and south, and finally flows toward the vicinity of the Caspian Sea. The three hydrological observation stations 1, 2, and 3 are marked on the main stream, among which 1 is located on the more upstream upper-right river section, 2 is located near the main stream in the middle reaches toward the left, and 3 is located on the downstream river section near the Caspian Sea. Then reason: The question asks to judge the tributary inflow situation in the river section from 2 to 3. Observing along the main stream between station 2 and station 3 in the figure, there are very few tributary lines connected to the main stream on both sides, and the river section basically appears as a single main stream extension, unlike the upstream or middle-reach parts where there are more tributary confluences. Therefore, few tributaries flow into the river section from 2 to 3.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中的乌拉尔河干流走向和1、2、3站位置；再根据题干锁定“2至3河段”。沿该河段查看两侧支流符号，统计或定性比较汇入干流的支流线数量。由于2至3段基本为单一干流，支流线稀疏，所以得出该河段支流汇入少。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是乌拉尔河水系示意图，干流大致从图的东北部向西南、南部延伸，最终流向里海附近。1、2、3三个水文观测站标在干流上，其中1位于较上游的右上部河段，2位于中游偏左的干流附近，3位于下游靠近里海的河段。再推理：题目要求判断2至3河段的支流汇入情况。沿图中2站到3站之间的干流观察，两侧连接到干流的支流线很少，河段基本表现为单一干流延伸，不像上游或中游部分有较多支流交汇。因此，2至3河段支流汇入少。
